name: Steel and Wire Products Co.
description: Steel and Wire Products was founded by Conrad Buedel in 1929 in downtown Baltimore. The focus was hand drive nails sold directly to the contractor. Much of Baltimore was built with nails from Steel and Wire. Conrad's son, J. Conrad Buedel started at Steel and Wire in 1956 and ultimately moved the company to a larger facility outside the city in the early 1970s. As the company grew customers enjoyed good service and looked to buy additional items. During the same time period, Steel and Wire shifted their sales focus to selling retail lumberyards and building supply houses. The company quickly expanded into screws and then collated nails. Always keeping their focus on Quality - Progress -Service. Major brands started to notice the value Steel and Wire delivered and looked to them to distribute their products. Today we are a major distributor of leading brands of metal connectors, fasteners, caulks, sealants, adhesives and poly. In the late 1970s Mark, J. Conrad's son started his career at Steel and Wire and today is the president. In 2009 Mark hired his son Reid and then a few years later hired his other son Scott to continue the tradition to 100 years and beyond!
